updates.tweet_text: Trading isn't a paid by the hour job and you don't get paid more for *doing more*. The opposite: You get paid for being a sniper. Planning spots, waiting on them, getting in, getting out. This may take 20mins a day. FOMOing from bell to bell just leads to overtrading & losses
